advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Make `test_binding_is_checked_before_any_review_work` monkeypatch the gate (`produce_code_review_verdict` / the lazy import) to append to `called`, so `assert called == []` actually proves the gate never ran before the mismatch was raised.
evidence: tests/unit/test_reviewed_tree_binding_heldout_da31.py:126 monkeypatches only `_resolve_reviewed_head`, not the gate, so nothing ever appends to `called`
tests/unit/test_reviewed_tree_binding_heldout_da31.py:131 `assert called == []` — an empty list compared to empty with no code path that could make it non-empty
Docstring claims 'Proven by the absence of any gate import/call on the mismatch path' but the ordering is enforced solely by `pytest.raises`; the `called == []` check is a no-op (regression-blind).
advisory.finding: `test_binding_is_checked_before_any_review_work` asserts `called == []` but never wires anything to append to `called` (the gate `produce_code_review_verdict` is not monkeypatched to record its invocation), so the assertion is vacuous and cannot detect a regression where review work runs before the binding check — the very ordering the test's docstring claims to prove.
scenarios: A refactor that moves `_assert_reviewed_tree` after the lazy gate import in `code_review_decision` would still let this test pass.
advisory.suggested_fix: Monkeypatch `rebar.llm.workflow.gate_dispatch.produce_code_review_verdict` (or patch the lazy import) to `called.append(...)`, so the empty-list assertion has a real signal to catch an ordering regression.

The only new voter test is `test_voter_votes_when_the_cloned_tree_is_the_voted_revision` (happy path); no test drives `CloningGerrit` with a mismatched revision to assert no vote / no dedup row / error status.
`CloningGerrit` materializes a real checkout, so passing `_event(revision=<wrong sha>)` would exercise the full refusal path — the seam is present but untested.
advisory.finding: The voter's new ReviewedTreeMismatch handling branch — the change's central behavioral claim that on a proven mismatch the voter casts NO vote (not even -1) and returns `status=error`/`stage=reviewed_tree_mismatch` — has no voter-level test; only the adapter seam and the happy path are covered.
scenarios: A regression that casts a -1 (instead of no vote) on mismatch, or that records a dedup row, would pass all tests.
